project_type: C language implementation - lexer, parser, compiler, register-based VM with NaN-boxing
build_system: Make (CMake available as well, but Make is simpler for this project)
test_framework: Custom C test harness with assertions + shell-based integration tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'make' to build the vek binary. 2. Run 'make test' to run unit and integration tests. 3. Run './build/vek --version' to verify the binary works. 4. Run './build/vek run tests/programs/hello.ve' to verify end-to-end execution.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - uses system clang/gcc and make which are pre-installed.
environment_constraints: Linux x86_64 with clang 15. No Windows support needed for v1. OPEN_INTERNET network mode.
contribution_requirements: Per design doc: deviations from the spec get a new version number or a new section, not silent drift.
key_patterns: NaN-boxed 64-bit values, register-based VM with computed GOTO dispatch, mark-and-sweep GC with 16KB heap pages, Ruby/Elixir-inspired syntax with end-delimited blocks
directory_structure: src/ - all C source and headers; tests/ - unit tests and integration test programs; docs/ - documentation and implementation plan; build/ - compiled output
